Infrastructure Lens/Multi-Region Production

Multi-Region Platform Infrastructure

Active-active deployment across two cloud regions with a global edge, regional Kubernetes clusters, managed relational stores, object storage, and a cross-region telemetry plane.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • Traffic enters at the global edge, is steered by geo-DNS and anycasting, then lands in one of two active regions.
  • Each region owns an ingress, a Kubernetes cluster, and a managed database; the primary replicates to the cross-region replica.
  • Object storage and the message bus are consumed by both clusters.

Critical Flows

  • User → CDN → Global LB → regional ingress → K8s service → RDS.
  • RDS Primary streams logical replication to RDS Replica.
  • Services push domain events to the message bus and store artifacts in object storage.

Operational Notes

  • Cross-region telemetry aggregates logs, metrics, and traces for both regions.
  • Failover switches traffic between regions; managed services must survive a single-region outage independently.
